topic: Project financing (background, not a GEM data column)
wiki_text: In June 2026, FOCOL Holdings closed a $379.2 million financing package for the LNG-to-power project, shortly after Shell's July 2026 FID. The package comprises a $335 million Bahamian-dollar syndicated loan from a consortium of CIBC Caribbean, RBC Royal Bank, Scotiabank, and Bank of The Bahamas, plus a $42.2 million USD tranche from the US Export-Import Bank (EXIM) and PEFCO (Private Export Funding Corporation), which closed June 5, 2026. First equipment shipments for the project were reported the same month.

source_urls.title: FOCOL signs $379.2M financing deal for LNG terminal
First equipment shipment next week for $379.2m LNG-to-power project
